description: A flat tabletop fills the scene, with a blue sponge cloth on the surface and a small spray bottle nearby. The left hand holds and slides the left-hand object (the blue sponge) back and forth across the tabletop, briefly lifting and repositioning it, while the right hand holds the right-hand object (the spray bottle) hovering over the area as if ready to spray, then steadies it while the left hand continues wiping.
